verdict.rationale: Cline's safety model is built around human-in-the-loop approval, diff review, checkpoints, and auto-approve settings (cline-docs-1, cline-docs-21, cline-docs-30), not sandboxed execution of code/tools/network. Kanban worktrees provide git isolation for parallel agents (cline-docs-24) but this is not a sandbox for code/tool/network execution. No evidence of containerized, VM-based, or otherwise isolated runtime environment for agent actions.
